# About the authors{ .unnumbered}

## J. David Urquiza Muñoz {-}

<a href="https://www.bgc-jena.mpg.de/~jurquiza/"><img src="https://www.bgc-jena.mpg.de/~jurquiza/Pictures/David%20Urquiza2.jpg" width="250" height="275" alt="David Urquiza" align="right" style="margin: 0 1em 0 1em" /></a>

**David Urquiza** (https://www.bgc-jena.mpg.de/~jurquiza/) is a Ecologist in tropical forest. Researcher at the Max Planck Institute for Biogeochemistry, and associate professor at the Forestry Science Faculty -- National University of the Peruvian Amazon. Researcher in geospatial Ecology and Remote Sensing, examining best practices for integrating field-based and remotely sensed data to understand spatio-temporal changes of forest attributes in the north western amazon.
